column1: # Desktop / GUI. KDE Plasma on CachyOS.
# NB: this list does NOT include Plasma itself. The CachyOS KDE edition installs
# the workspace, SDDM/plasmalogin, Breeze, the portal and the core KDE apps at
# install time. Listing them here would be redundant, and `--needed` would make
# them no-ops anyway. What IS listed: the things the edition does not give you,
# plus the KDE apps actually used day to day, so a rebuild is reproducible.
# NB: the reason this file is short again is worth recording. It briefly carried
# a ~45-package niri + Noctalia session - compositor, shell, portals, polkit
# agent, notification daemon, screen locker, idle daemon, clipboard manager,
# GTK/Qt theming, and replacements for six KDE apps. All of that is what Plasma
# provides out of the box, and measured on this machine the whole Plasma session
